items.headline: Kyiv: North Korea ki KN-23 missile ka istemal
items.detail: Zelenskyy ke mutabik prarambhik jaanch me ek key energy site par North Korea ki KN-23 missile mili; raat bhar chali 36 missiles me se sirf 4 roki gayin.
items.exam_angle: Russia-North Korea sainya sahyog aur pratibandh — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Houthi: Riyadh airport, Aramco par hamle ka daava
items.detail: Houthiyon ne 6 missile-drone hamlo ka daava kiya — Riyadh airport aur Aramco sites nishane par; Saudi ne abhi pushti nahi ki, daave ki swatantra pushti nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Paschim Asia sangharsh aur tel suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Democrats ki jaanch ka aadesh
items.detail: Trump ne Justice Department ko Democrats ki jaanch ka aadesh diya, aarop hai ki ve mahaabhiyog ki dhamki dekar 'dabaav' bana rahe hain; unhone koi saboot nahi diya.
items.exam_angle: America me midterm ke baad satta santulan aur Congress ki nigrani — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Sanaa: Hawai hamle me 27 ki maut
items.detail: Sanaa ke paas al-Shariya gaon par hawai hamle me Houthi-run health ministry ke anusar kam se kam 27 ki maut aur 36 ghayal hue; Houthis ne Saudi Arabia par aarop lagaya, Riyadh ne abhi koi tippani nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: Yemen grih yuddh aur Saudi-Houthi sangharsh — Madhya Purv ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Qeshm-Jask: Hormuz kinare phir dhamake
items.detail: Iran ke sarkari media ke anusar Qeshm dweep aur Jask, Sirik aur Bandar Abbas me dhamakon ki awaazein suni gayin; wajah abhi saaf nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur America-Iran tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha aur urja ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Israel: Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ka mauka
items.detail: Rashtrapati Isaac Herzog ne Netanyahu ke pratidvandi Gadi Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ka mauka diya; 67 sansadon ne unka samarthan kiya, Netanyahu ko 46 mile, aur Eisenkot ke paas 28 din hain.
items.exam_angle: Israel me sarkar gathan aur Knesset ki bhoomika — Madhya Purv ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Ronen Horesh / Knesset Archives, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: CENTCOM: Iran ki zameeni supply par rok
items.detail: America ki Central Command ne Task Force Iron Gate banayi hai jo Iran ki zameeni seemaon aur Caspian Sea se hathiyaron aur pratibandhit saaman ki aavaajahi rokegi.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav me nakabandi ka vistaar — Hormuz aur samudri vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Paraguay: Peña prosecutors ke saamne pesh hue
items.detail: Ueno Bank ke collapse par Senate ne Peña ko hataya tha; house arrest ke baad woh shanivaar subah Attorney General ke saamne pesh hue, Alliana naye rashtrapati ban chuke hain.
items.exam_angle: Mahabhiyog aur banking sankat — governance aur vittiya niyaman ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Presidencia de Ecuador, public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: America: Dhillon ne Civil Rights pad chhoda
items.detail: Trump prashasan ki pehli badi vidai — Attorney General ne 5 November ko Harmeet Dhillon ka istifa sweekar kiya; woh April 2025 se Civil Rights Division ki pramukh thi.
items.exam_angle: Midterm ke baad pehli badi vidai — America ki rajneeti aur nagrik adhikar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: France: School bus haadse me do ki maut
items.detail: Lyon se Bourg-en-Bresse ja rahi bus ped se takra gayi; saat saal ki ladki aur 18 saal ke yuva ki maut, 16 ghayal, teen ki haalat gambhir.

items.headline: New Zealand: Chunav me koi vijeta nahi
items.detail: National ko 42 aur Labour ko 36 seatein mili; Labour ko vote share me halki badhat, lekin sarkar ka faisla 27 November ke aadhikarik natije par tika.
items.exam_angle: MMP chunav pranali aur hung parliament — loktantra ke liye mahatvapurna.
